description: Let agentsvc.io poll for you: we run page-watch, feed-watch, wallet-watch, token-watch every interval_minutes (5 to 1440) and POST to webhook_url only when something changed (signed with X-Agentsvc-Signature, HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body with the returned webhook_secret). Each check costs the normal price of that service, charged from prepaid credit: send "Authorization: Bearer <credit token>" on the MCP transport (top up at https://agentsvc.io/api/v1/proxy/credits-topup-1). Up to 50 active watches per token.

input.description: Same parameters as the service, e.g. {"url": "https://..."} or {"token": "0x...", "chain": "base"}

webhook_url.description: https URL that receives {event, watch_id, service, result}

name: watch_create
title: Create a webhook watch (we poll for you)
